lastCompletedStory.title: Bloco idle no payload quando prd.json esta ausente

nextStoryContext: GET /api/snapshot now adds idleState only when resolvePrdPath(cwd) is absent. idleState.recentCycles contains the newest five cycle rows (newest first) after skipping the physical header line; idleState.backlog is derived from readBacklogFromMain plus deriveBacklogJson. Missing cycle metrics and backlog read failures preserve HTTP success with empty derived data.
